meta.title: Case studies — Viviana Rames
meta.description: Selected marketing case studies from Capture6, Harvest Thermal, Brush It On and Skytree.

intro.heading: Selected case studies
intro.text: How I've positioned complex products, built brands and created demand, for consumer and B2B audiences.

cases.title: Building a brand and demand from zero
cases.outcome: As first marketing hire at a seed-stage carbon removal and water recovery company, I grew organic inbound inquiries 200% YoY, with coverage in Forbes and The Verge.

lead.alt: Animated diagram of Project Monarch showing water treatment, carbon removal, mineralized carbonates and freshwater recovery

sections.label: The challenge
sections.text: A seed-stage climate-tech company with no marketing function and a technology few buyers understood.

sections.label: My role
sections.text: First marketing hire. Built and led a team of two, plus agency and freelance partners.

sections.label: What I did
items: Mapped target segments and ICPs, then built the brand, positioning and three core market propositions.
Built the website, HubSpot CRM, content, PR, events and sales enablement.
Led communications for Project Monarch, Capture6's first integrated water recovery and direct air capture project, including the animated explainer above, developed with an external designer.
Ran executive thought leadership and media relations.
Set up reporting, ran marketing against quarterly OKRs and reported performance to the board.

sections.label: The result
sections.text: Organic inbound inquiries grew 200% YoY, with coverage in Forbes and The Verge and a company presence at COP28 and New York Climate Week.

cases.title: Selling a high-ticket upgrade to design-conscious homeowners
cases.outcome: A campaign strategy for affluent Bay Area Eichler owners, built on one insight: their biggest barrier to going electric wasn't cost, it was protecting their home's architecture.

lead.alt: Top of the Harvest flyer: Electrify your Eichler without architectural compromise

sections.label: The challenge
sections.text: Persuade affluent Bay Area Eichler owners, who prize their homes' mid-century architecture, to replace gas heating with a heat pump and thermal battery.

sections.label: The insight
sections.text: For these owners, the biggest barrier wasn't cost. It was fear that a standard retrofit would cut into the clean walls and wood ceilings that define an Eichler. But their radiant floors are already ideal for a heat pump.

sections.label: What I did
items: Developed the campaign strategy for the Eichler segment.
Shaped a campaign that leads with preserving the architecture, explains the system in three steps, removes the price objection with $0-down financing, and invites owners to a 2-minute Home Fit Check.

media.alt: Full Harvest flyer with problem, fit, how it works, financing and a QR code call to action
media.caption: Campaign flyer for Bay Area Eichler homeowners

cases.title: A consumer brand, from founding to sale
cases.outcome: I founded a sustainable personal-care brand, grew it 250% YoY to 150+ retail and wholesale partners across Australia, and sold it in 2022.

lead.alt: Brush It On product range: bamboo toothbrushes, straws, cotton buds, dental floss and cutlery

sections.label: The challenge
sections.text: Launch a new sustainable consumer brand and build demand online and in retail.

sections.label: My role
sections.text: Founder, owning brand, product, marketing and sales.

sections.label: What I did
items: Built the brand identity and a sustainability-led value proposition.
Developed and launched a range of 40+ products.
Ran DTC e-commerce, creator and influencer partnerships, and PR.
Built the wholesale network, supported by a wholesale catalogue.

sections.label: The result
sections.text: 250% YoY growth to ~A$300K annual revenue, 150+ retail and wholesale partners across Australia, and the business sold in 2022.

cases.title: Events that convert, and a launch that landed
cases.outcome: For a direct air capture company expanding into North America, I lifted event lead-to-SQL conversion 30% and led communications for the $100M Project Concho.

lead.alt: Skytree booth at an industry event, and Skytree's VP of Sales speaking on stage

sections.label: The challenge
sections.text: Turn trade-show presence into qualified pipeline while expanding into North America.

sections.label: My role
sections.text: Led global communications, events and launch communications.

sections.label: What I did
items: Built the 2025 message house and repositioned the company for industrial buyers across 11 verticals.
Managed participation in eight industry events across three continents, and produced webinars.
Rebuilt lead capture and nurture in HubSpot.
Secured a conference speaking slot for Skytree's VP of Sales (pictured above).
Led communications for Project Concho, plus joint announcements with Deep Sky and Return Carbon.

sections.label: The result

cases.title: I've lived the product
cases.outcome: Close to two years on the road in RVs across Australia and the Americas, and more than a decade in a 100,000-member overlanding community.

lead.alt: A pop-top camper trailer at a grassy campsite, with a hammock strung between trees

paragraphs: Across several trips, I've spent close to two years on the road in RVs, traveling through Australia and North and South America.
For more than a decade I've been an active member of Pan-American Highway Travelers, a Facebook community of over 100,000 overlanders who share routes, border-crossing tips and meetups.

I know how much thought goes into choosing a rig, how proud owners are of them, and how generously they share what they've learned with each other. That's the kind of community I want to build marketing around.
